label: Experts X2: a full-rudder turn at 7 mph, flat calm

test.title: Experts X2: a full-rudder turn at 7 mph, flat calm
test.purpose: The turning circle with the rudder alone: hold a full key and watch.
lookFor: the time for a full circle (the compass), the speed lost (Speed), the rudder's force and whether it stalls (Rudder)
questions: What radius and time for a full circle at full rudder, paddling at a steady tempo with no sweep or correcting strokes?
How much speed does the turn cost?
How long after the pedal moves does the boat answer?
test.compare: Add &boat=v3 to the address for the vNext boat (sway, yaw and a rudder foil that stalls and ventilates; &rudder=large for the large blade). The Engineering instruments show the rudder, the yaw split, the drift and the wave's push.
